section_summary: This section continues a SCAP tabular register of Japanese ship radio stations, listing registration numbers, vessel names, ports of registry, tonnage, operating agents, call signs, frequency changes, and emission classes. It completes listings for Chiba and Tokyo, then covers Kanagawa, Ishikawa, Aichi, and part of Shizuoka prefectures. The vessels include merchant ships, fishing and whaling vessels, tankers, weather and training ships, salvage craft, cable ships, survey boats, and Maritime Safety Bureau craft.

subfiles.title: SCAP register of ship radio stations for the Tokyo, Kanazawa, and Nagoya regions (continuation)
subfiles.about: Continuation of a regional register identifying Japanese vessels and their authorized radio-station particulars.
subfiles.summary: The register records SCAP registration numbers, vessel names, registry ports, tonnage, operating agencies, call signs, authorized frequencies or frequency amendments, and emission types. Pages 161–222 cover the remainder of Chiba and Tokyo listings; pages 223–236 cover Kanagawa; page 237 covers Ishikawa; page 238 covers Aichi; and pages 239–240 begin Shizuoka. Entries encompass commercial cargo ships, tankers, fishing and whaling vessels, meteorological ships, training vessels, salvage craft, cable ships, survey boats, and Maritime Safety Bureau vessels.
